title: F1 in the Netherlands: The driver you most want to beat is your teammate
summary: Button’s teammate Rubens Barrichello would win two more races for Brawn that year, but by year’s end, Red Bull and McLaren had both caught up with, then eclipsed, Brawn’s pace.
